_comment: Waterbike AI tier limits. Read at runtime by plan_generator.py.
Single source of truth for tier limits. If missing or malformed the engine
falls back to identical built-in defaults, logs the reason, and still
Three wind zones per Safety Canon v1.3 section 2:
wind <= comfort_wind        no penalty, conditions are pleasant
comfort_wind < wind <= max_wind   Caution band, penalty ramps
squall_tolerance is judged on gust minus sustained, not absolute gust.
A 15 mph gust on 11 sustained is ordinary; 26 on 11 is squally.
max_exposure, max_leg_mi and max_total_mi are structural gates. They
describe the route, not the weather, so they block a tier on a glassy
Changing any number is a change to the safety envelope and requires
operator sign off per Canon section 2.

units.comfort_wind: mph sustained, no penalty at or below
units.squall_tolerance: mph of gust-minus-sustained tolerated before penalty
units.max_exposure: highest leg exposure index this tier may ride
units.max_leg_mi: longest single leg this tier may ride
units.max_total_mi: total route distance this tier may ride
